about_the_game:
Overview

100 Caliber Dash hurls you into a neon-soaked death race. In a high-stakes, retro-futuristic stadium, you tear through drone-infested courses, gunning for the fastest time. One health bar, ten escalating levels, no second chances. Speed, precision, and style reign supreme. Climb the leaderboard or crash in the chaos.

Key Features

Fluid Movement: Fast walking, dashing, and double jumps let you weave through the chaos with precision and elegance.

Dual-Wield Action: Fire left and right independently, with separate magazines ensuring relentless momentum.

Dynamic Upgrades: Build unique pistol synergies each run by drawing from a deck of powerful upgrade cards at the end of each level and assigning them to a specific pistol.

Ever-Increasing Challenge: Face escalating enemy waves, evolving hazards, and fierce competition on the live online leaderboard.

Retrowave Aesthetic: A neon-drenched stadium, pulsating synthwave soundtrack, and a quirky retro announcer bringing this competition to life.
